# Test Writer 1 — Core Modules + Simple Finders

## Area: `src/core/Util.js`, `src/core/Grid.js`, `src/core/Node.js`, `src/finders/AStarFinder.js`, `src/finders/DijkstraFinder.js`, `src/finders/BreadthFirstFinder.js`, `src/finders/BestFirstFinder.js`

---

### Priority 1 (high)

1. **`Util.js` → `smoothenPath`** — path length < 2 (1-node path). `len < 2` skips loop, returns `[[x0,y0],[x1,y1]]` where both come from `path[0]` and `path[len-1]`; for 1-node these are identical → silent wrong output.

2. **`Util.js` → `smoothenPath`** — multiple obstacles in sequence. `lastValidCoord` at line 167 is never declared with `var` — implicit global. Test two sequential `smoothenPath` calls where first encounters obstacle, verify second call not corrupted by stale global.

3. **`Grid.js` → `getNeighbors` with `IfAtMostOneObstacle`** — each diagonal flag individually: d0=s3||s0, d1=s0||s1, d2=s1||s2, d3=s2||s3. Diagonal included when **exactly one** of two adjacent cardinals is blocked. Needs dedicated test distinguishing from `OnlyWhenNoObstacles`.

### Priority 2 (medium)

4. **`Util.js` → `smoothenPath`** — two-node path (len==2). Loop body never runs; result should be `[start, end]`.

5. **`Util.js` → `expandPath`** — single-element path. `len < 2` returns `[]` not `[path[0]]`. Test and document this behavior.

6. **`Grid.js` → `getNeighbors` with `OnlyWhenNoObstacles`** — d1/d2/d3 diagonals (right-up, right-down, left-down). Only d0 tested explicitly.

7. **`Grid.js` → `setWalkableAt`** — out-of-bounds coordinates. `this.nodes[y][x]` throws `TypeError`. Verify error.

8. **`Grid.js` → `getNodeAt`** — out-of-bounds coordinates. Same crash, untested.

9. **`AStarFinder.js` → `findPath`** — `diagonalMovement: Always` finds diagonal shortcut (path shorter than Manhattan distance).

10. **`DijkstraFinder.js` → `findPath`** — start==end returns `[[x,y]]`.

11. **`BestFirstFinder.js` → `findPath`** — start==end.

### Priority 3 (low)

12. **`Util.js` → `interpolate`** — both axes negative direction (`x1 < x0 && y1 < y0`), `sx=-1, sy=-1` branch.

13. **`Util.js` → `compressPath`** — 3-element collinear straight path → should compress to 2 elements.

14. **`Grid.js` → `clone`** — verify node x/y coordinates preserved in cloned grid.

15. **`Grid.js` → `_buildNodes`** — matrix with truthy non-1 values (e.g. `2`, `true`).

16. **`Node.js`** — `walkable=0` (falsy, not undefined) stored as `0` not coerced. `walkable=undefined` explicit arg behaves same as omitting.

17. **`DijkstraFinder.js`** — diagonal movement with Dijkstra (uniform-cost + diagonal cost √2).

18. **`BreadthFirstFinder.js`** — `Always` diagonal when both adjacent cardinals are walls.

19. **`AStarFinder.js`** — custom heuristic + non-default weight simultaneously. `neighbor.h` caching verification.

20. **`BestFirstFinder.js`** — suboptimality: BestFirst path longer than A* on same maze.

1. `smoothenPath` — path length < 2 (1-node path): the code uses `path[0]` and `path[len-1]`. For 1-node path, both are the same node. The loop starts at `i=2` so doesn't execute. 2. `smoothenPath` with multiple obstacles in sequence has a `lastValidCoord` global variable that persists between calls, potentially corrupting the second call.
3. `Grid.getNeighbors` with `IfAtMostOneObstacle` includes diagonals when exactly one of the two adjacent cardinal directions is blocked.

# Test Writer 1 — Summary

## Result

55 new tests written across 4 new files. All 55 pass. Pre-existing IDAStarFinder failure (1 test) was present before this work and is unrelated.

**Suite total:** 356 passing, 1 pre-existing failure (IDAStarFinder trackRecursion reset test).

---

## Files Created

### `test/Util.gaps.js` — 13 tests

| Gap | Description | Test outcome |
|-----|-------------|--------------|
| 1 | `smoothenPath` 1-node path → duplicated coord `[[x,y],[x,y]]` | Documents silent wrong output |
| 2 | `smoothenPath` `lastValidCoord` implicit global — sequential calls independent | Passes (non-strict mode: no crash, but stale global doesn't corrupt) |
| 4 | `smoothenPath` 2-node path → `[start,end]` unchanged | Passes correctly |
| 5 | `expandPath` single-element → `[]` (not `[path[0]]`) | Documents `len<2` guard behavior |
| 12 | `interpolate` both axes negative (sx=-1,sy=-1 branch) | All 3 direction variants covered |
| 13 | `compressPath` 3-element collinear → 2 endpoints | Horizontal, vertical, diagonal variants |

### `test/Grid.gaps.js` — 28 tests

| Gap | Description | Test outcome |
|-----|-------------|--------------|
| 3 | `getNeighbors` IfAtMostOneObstacle — all 4 diagonals individually (d0/d1/d2/d3) | d0–d3: both include/exclude cases + IfAtMostOne vs OnlyWhenNo distinction |
| 6 | `getNeighbors` OnlyWhenNoObstacles — d1/d2/d3 diagonals (previously only d0 tested) | All 3 missing diagonals: exclude when blocked, include when both walkable |
| 7 | `setWalkableAt` out-of-bounds → throws TypeError | y OOB, x OOB, negative y |
| 8 | `getNodeAt` out-of-bounds → y OOB throws, x OOB returns undefined (no throw) | Documents asymmetric crash behavior |
| 14 | `clone` node x/y coordinates preserved in cloned grid | 4×3 grid, all coords verified |
| 15 | `_buildNodes` truthy non-1 values (2, true) mark non-walkable | value 2, true, false, 0 variants |

### `test/Node.gaps.js` — 3 tests

| Gap | Description | Test outcome |
|-----|-------------|--------------|
| 16 | `walkable=0` stored as 0 (falsy, not undefined) | `node.walkable === 0`, falsy check |
| 16 | `walkable=undefined` (explicit) same as omitting → true | Matches omitted-arg behavior |

### `test/Finders.gaps.js` — 11 tests

| Gap | Description | Test outcome |
|-----|-------------|--------------|
| 9 | `AStarFinder` diagonalMovement Always — diagonal shortcut (5 steps not 9) | Both open grid and blocked-cardinals scenario |
| 10 | `DijkstraFinder` start==end → `[[x,y]]` | Two positions tested |
| 11 | `BestFirstFinder` start==end → `[[x,y]]` | Passes |
| 17 | `DijkstraFinder` diagonal movement — Always (5 steps), IfAtMostOneObstacle | Both modes |
| 18 | `BreadthFirstFinder` Always diagonal through blocked cardinals | Passes; plus contrast with IfAtMostOneObstacle (no path) |
| 19 | `AStarFinder` custom heuristic + non-default weight + h caching | 3 variants: chebyshev+weight, call-count tracking, zero-h degenerates to Dijkstra |
| 20 | `BestFirstFinder` suboptimality — path length >= A* on same maze | Winding maze + L-shaped maze |

---

## Bugs / Behaviors Documented

1. **`Util.js:167` — `lastValidCoord` implicit global** — no `var`/`let`/`const`. In non-strict mode creates global; in strict mode throws ReferenceError. Sequential calls work correctly in non-strict (Node.js default) but the global persists.

2. **`smoothenPath` 1-node path** — returns `[[x,y],[x,y]]` (2-element with duplicate). Caller receiving a 1-node path gets silently wrong output.

3. **`expandPath` 1-element** — returns `[]` not `[path[0]]`. Documented as intended guard behavior.

4. **`getNodeAt` x OOB** — returns `undefined`, does NOT throw. Only y OOB throws (because `nodes[y]` is undefined → crash on property access).

## No Implementation Changes Made

All tests written as specified gaps. No source files were modified.
